definitions.explanation: The period of life roughly from the late thirties to the mid-fifties, considered a person's most productive and vigorous adult years. In Japanese usage this often emphasizes capability and maturity rather than decline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{壮年|そうねん}{期|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
{壮年|そうねん}{期|き}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だ。
examples.english: Middle age is a period when physical strength and experience are well balanced.

examples.japanese: {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{中心的|ちゅうしんてき}→中心的：05676_chuushinteki⟧な⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}う→担う：12787_ninau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Men in their prime often play a central role both at work and in the family.

notes:
Refers to the stage of life between youth ({青年期|せいねんき}) and old age (⟦{老年期|ろうねんき}→老年期：23970_rounenki⟧), typically spanning the late thirties through the fifties. The term carries a positive nuance of being at the peak of one's powers, unlike English "middle age" which can imply decline.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to enter middle age
- {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧: middle-aged man
- {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: middle-aged woman
- {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach one's prime

LIFE STAGE SEQUENCE:
- {幼年期|ようねんき}: early childhood
- {少年期|しょうねんき}: boyhood/girlhood
- {青年期|せいねんき}: youth
- {壮年期|そうねんき}: prime of life / middle age
- {中年期|ちゅうねんき}: middle age (more neutral)
- ⟦{老年期|ろうねんき}→老年期：23970_rounenki⟧: old age

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧: middle age — more neutral and sometimes negative; {壮年期|そうねんき} emphasizes vigor
- ⟦{働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り→働き盛り：28201_hatarakizakari⟧: prime working years — focuses specifically on career productivity
